doc.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Pannonica Koenigswarter, benefactress
summary: He credits Pannonica de Koenigswarter with helping Monk, Sonny Clark and Art Blakey out of poverty.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Yes, yes. We could mention that Monk and myself, Sonny Clark, a lot of musicians were very thankful to a lady, I should mention her, we were very thankful to
this lady who loved jazz and became a benefactress for all of us, you know, Art Blakey, all of us. See, she was…
Her name was Pannonica Koenigswarter nee Rothschild, Rothschild. She was the benefactress who helped us all get out of being poor and starving, you know, so that we can mention.
